025    private static SimpleDateFormat dateFormatFront = new SimpleDateFormat("ddHHmmss", Locale.US);
026    private static SimpleDateFormat dateFormatBack = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMyyyy", Locale.US);
027    private static SimpleDateFormat dateFormatFull = new SimpleDateFormat("ddHHmmssZMMMyyyy", Locale.US);
028    private static SimpleDateFormat dateFormatZulu = new SimpleDateFormat("Z", Locale.US);

030    //this regex is from: https://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/java/lang/Double.html
031    private static final String Digits     = "(\\p{Digit}+)";
032    private static final String HexDigits  = "(\\p{XDigit}+)";
033    // an exponent is 'e' or 'E' followed by an optionally
034    // signed decimal integer.
035    private static final String Exp        = "[eE][+-]?"+Digits;
036    private static final String fpRegex    =
037            ("[\\x00-\\x20]*"+  // Optional leading "whitespace"
038                    "[+-]?(" + // Optional sign character
039                    "NaN|" +           // "NaN" string
040                    "Infinity|" +      // "Infinity" string
041
042                    // A decimal floating-point string representing a finite positive
043                    // number without a leading sign has at most five basic pieces:
044                    // Digits . Digits ExponentPart FloatTypeSuffix
045                    //
046                    // Since this method allows integer-only strings as input
047                    // in addition to strings of floating-point literals, the
048                    // two sub-patterns below are simplifications of the grammar
049                    // productions from section 3.10.2 of
050                    // The Java™ Language Specification.
051
052                    // Digits ._opt Digits_opt ExponentPart_opt FloatTypeSuffix_opt
053                    "((("+Digits+"(\\.)?("+Digits+"?)("+Exp+")?)|"+
054
055                    // . Digits ExponentPart_opt FloatTypeSuffix_opt
056                    "(\\.("+Digits+")("+Exp+")?)|"+
057
058                    // Hexadecimal strings
059                    "((" +
060                    // 0[xX] HexDigits ._opt BinaryExponent FloatTypeSuffix_opt
061                    "(0[xX]" + HexDigits + "(\\.)?)|" +
062
063                    // 0[xX] HexDigits_opt . HexDigits BinaryExponent FloatTypeSuffix_opt
064                    "(0[xX]" + HexDigits + "?(\\.)" + HexDigits + ")" +
065
066                    ")[pP][+-]?" + Digits + "))" +
067                    "[fFdD]?))" +
068                    "[\\x00-\\x20]*");// Optional trailing "whitespace"
069
070    private static final Pattern pIsNumber = Pattern.compile(fpRegex);
071
072    /**
073     * Determines if a String represents a valid number
074     *
075     * @param text {@link String}
076     * @return "1.56" == true, "1ab" == false
077     */
078    public static boolean isNumber(String text)
079    {
080        return pIsNumber.matcher(text).matches();
081    }

115    /**
116     * Converts a Java Date object into a properly formatted String for W or W1.
117     * DDHHMMSSZMONYYYY
118     * Field W: D = day, H = hour, M = minute, S = second, Z = Greenwich or local time, MON= month and Y = year.
119     * @param time {@link Date}
120     * @return {@link String}
121     */
122    public static String getDateLabel(Date time)
123    {
124
125        String modifierString = null;
126
127        String zulu = "";
128        zulu = dateFormatZulu.format(time);
129
130        if (zulu != null && zulu.length() == 5)
131        {
132
133            if (zulu.startsWith("+"))//Integer.valueOf doesn't like '+'
134            {
135                zulu = zulu.substring(1, 3);
136            }
137            else
138            {
139                zulu = zulu.substring(0, 3);
140            }
141
142            int intZulu = Integer.valueOf(zulu);
143
144            zulu = getZuluCharFromTimeZoneOffset(intZulu);
145        }
146        else
147        {
148            zulu = getZuluCharFromTimeZoneOffset(time);
149        }
150
151        modifierString = dateFormatFront.format(time) + zulu + dateFormatBack.format(time);
152
153        return modifierString.toUpperCase();
154    }

156    /**
157     * Given date, return character String representing which NATO time zone
158     * you're in.
159     *
160     * @param time {@link Date}
161     * @return {@link String}
162     */
163    private static String getZuluCharFromTimeZoneOffset(Date time)
164    {
165        TimeZone tz = TimeZone.getDefault();
166        Date offset = new Date(tz.getOffset(time.getTime()));
167        long lOffset = offset.getTime() / 3600000;//3600000 = (1000(ms)*60(s)*60(m))
168
169        int hour = (int) lOffset;
170
171        return getZuluCharFromTimeZoneOffset(hour);
172    }
173

218        }

289    /**
290     * Determines if a symbol, based on it's symbol ID, can have the specified modifier/amplifier.
291     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
292     * @param modifier {@link Modifiers}
293     * @return {@link Boolean}
294     */
295    public static Boolean hasModifier(String symbolID, String modifier)
296    {
297        MSInfo msi = MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolID);
298
299        if(msi != null)//  && msi.getDrawRule() != DrawRules.DONOTDRAW)
300        {
301            ArrayList<String> mods = msi.getModifiers();
302
303            if(mods != null && mods.contains(modifier))
304                return true;
305            else if(msi.getSymbolSet() == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure && modifier.equals(Modifiers.AB_FEINT_DUMMY_INDICATOR))
306                return true;
307            else
308                return false;
309        }
310        return false;
311    }

313    /**
314     * Gets Basic Symbol ID which is the Symbol Set + Entity Code
315     * @param id 30 Character {@link String}
316     * @return 8 character {@link String} (Symbol Set + Entity Code)
317     */
318    public static String getBasicSymbolID(String id)
319    {
320        if(id.length() == 8)
321        {
322            return id;
323        }
324        else if(id.startsWith("B"))
325            return id;
326        else if(id.equals("octagon"))
327            return id;
328        else if (id.length() >= 20 && id.length() <= 30)
329        {
330            String key = id.substring(4, 6) + id.substring(10, 16);
331            return key;
332        }
333        else if (id.length()==15)
334        {
335            return getBasicSymbolID2525C(id);
336        }
337        return id;
338    }
339
340    /**
341     * Gets the basic Symbol ID for a 2525C symbol
342     * S*F*GPU---*****
343     * G*G*GPP---****X
344     * @param strSymbolID 15 Character {@link String}
345     * @return 15 Character {@link String}
346     */
347    public static String getBasicSymbolID2525C(String strSymbolID)
348    {
349        if(strSymbolID != null && strSymbolID.length() == 15)
350        {
351            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
352            char scheme = strSymbolID.charAt(0);
353            if (scheme == 'G')
354            {
355                sb.append(strSymbolID.charAt(0));
356                sb.append("*");
357                sb.append(strSymbolID.charAt(2));
358                sb.append("*");
359                sb.append(strSymbolID.substring(4, 10));
360                sb.append("****X");
361            }
362            else if (scheme != 'W' && scheme != 'B' && scheme != 'P')
363            {
364                sb.append(strSymbolID.charAt(0));
365                sb.append("*");
366                sb.append(strSymbolID.charAt(2));
367                sb.append("*");
368                sb.append(strSymbolID.substring(4, 10));
369                if(sb.toString().startsWith("S*G*I"))//Installation
370                    sb.append("H****");
371                else if(sb.toString().startsWith("I"))//SIGINT
372                    sb.append("--***");
373                else//Warfighting and anything else
374                    sb.append("*****");
375            }
376            else
377            {
378                return strSymbolID;
379            }
380            return sb.toString();
381        }
382        return strSymbolID;
383    }

385    /**
386     * Attempts to resolve a bad symbol ID into a value that can be found in {@link MSLookup}.
387     * If it fails, it will return the symbol code for a invalid symbol which is displayed as
388     * an inverted question mark (110098000010000000000000000000)
389     * @param symbolID 30 character {@link String}
390     * @return 30 character {@link String} representing the resolved symbol ID.
391     */
392    public static String reconcileSymbolID(String symbolID)
393    {
394
395        String newID = "";
396        try {
397
398
399            int v = SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID);
400            if (v < SymbolID.Version_APP6D)
401                newID = String.valueOf(SymbolID.Version_2525Dch1);
402            else if(v > SymbolID.Version_APP6Ech2)
403                newID = String.valueOf(SymbolID.Version_2525Ech1);
404            v = SymbolID.getVersion(newID);
405            int c = SymbolID.getContext(symbolID);
406            if (c > 4)
407                newID += String.valueOf(SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Context_Reality);
408            else
409                newID += String.valueOf(c);
410            int a = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
411            if (a > 6)
412                newID += String.valueOf(SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Unknown);
413            else
414                newID += String.valueOf(a);
415            int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
416            switch (ss) {
417                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Unknown:
418                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Air:
419                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_AirMissile:
420                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Air:
421                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Space:
422                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SpaceMissile:
423                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Space:
424                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandUnit:
425                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandCivilianUnit_Organization:
426                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandEquipment:
427                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Land:
428                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandInstallation:
429                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_DismountedIndividuals:
430                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SeaSurface:
431                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_SeaSurface:
432                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SeaSubsurface:
433                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_MineWarfare:
434                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_SeaSubsurface:
435                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Activities:
436                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure:
437                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Atmospheric:
438                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Oceanographic:
439                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_MeteorologicalSpace:
440                case SymbolID.SymbolSet_CyberSpace:
441                    newID += String.format("%02d",ss);
442                    break;
443                default:
444                    newID += String.format("%02d", SymbolID.SymbolSet_Unknown);//String.valueOf(SymbolID.SymbolSet_Unknown);
445            }
446
447            int s = SymbolID.getStatus(symbolID);
448            if (s > SymbolID.Status_Present_FullToCapacity)
449                newID += String.valueOf(SymbolID.Status_Present);
450            else
451                newID += String.valueOf(s);
452
453            newID += String.valueOf(SymbolID.getHQTFD(symbolID));//just add, won't get used if value bad
454            newID += String.format("%02d",SymbolID.getAmplifierDescriptor(symbolID));//just add, won't get used if value bad
455
456            int ec = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
457
458            if (ec == 0)
459                newID += "000000";//root symbol for symbol set
460            else if (SVGLookup.getInstance().getSVGLInfo(SVGLookup.getMainIconID(newID + ec + "0000"), v) == null) {
461                //set to blank symbol
462                newID += "000000";
463                /*//set to invalid symbol since we couldn't find it in the lookup
464                newID = SymbolID.setSymbolSet(newID, 98);
465                newID += 100000;//*/
466            }
467            else
468                newID += String.format("%06d",ec);//we found it so add the entity code
469
470            //newID += SymbolID.getMod1ID(symbolID);//just add, won't get used if value bad
471            //newID += SymbolID.getMod2ID(symbolID);//just add, won't get used if value bad
472            newID += symbolID.substring(16);//just add, won't get used if value bad
473        }
474        catch(Exception exc)
475        {
476            newID = "110098000010000000000000000000";//invalid symbol
477        }
478
479        return newID;
480    }

482    /**
483     * Gets line color used if no line color has been set. The color is specified based on the affiliation of
484     * the symbol and whether it is a unit or not.
485     * @param symbolID 30 character {@link String}
486     * @return {@link Color}
487     */
488    public static Color getLineColorOfAffiliation(String symbolID)
489    {
490        Color retColor = null;
491
492        int symbolSet = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
493        int set = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
494        int affiliation = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
495        int symStd = SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID);
496        int entityCode = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
497
498        try
499        {
500            // We can't get the line color if there is no symbol id, since that also means there is no affiliation
501            if((symbolID == null) || (symbolID.equals("")))
502            {
503                return retColor;
504            }
505
506            if(symbolSet == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure)
507            {
508                int entity = SymbolID.getEntity(symbolID);
509                int entityType = SymbolID.getEntityType(symbolID);
510                int entitySubtype = SymbolID.getEntitySubtype(symbolID);
511
512                if(SymbolUtilities.isGreenProtectionGraphic(entity, entityType, entitySubtype))
513                {
514                    //Obstacles/Protection Graphics, some are green obstacles and we need to
515                    //check for those.
516                    retColor = AffiliationColors.ObstacleGreen;
517                }
518                //just do color by affiliation if no other color has been set yet.
519                if(retColor == null)
520                {
521                    switch (affiliation) {
522                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend:
523                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend:
524                            retColor = AffiliationColors.FriendlyGraphicLineColor;//Color.BLACK;//0x000000;     // Black
525                            break;
526                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker:
527                            retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileGraphicLineColor;//Color.RED;//0xff0000;        // Red
528                            break;
529                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker:
530                            if(symStd >= SymbolID.Version_2525E && symStd <= SymbolID.Version_2525Ech1)
531                                retColor = AffiliationColors.SuspectGraphicLineColor;//255,188,1
532                            else
533                                retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileGraphicLineColor;//Color.RED;//0xff0000;    // Red
534                            break;
535                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Neutral:
536                            retColor = AffiliationColors.NeutralGraphicLineColor;//Color.GREEN;//0x00ff00;      // Green
537                            break;
538                        default:
539                            retColor = AffiliationColors.UnknownGraphicLineColor;//Color.YELLOW;//0xffff00;     // Yellow
540                            break;
541                    }
542                }
543            }
544            else if (set >= 45 && set <= 47)//METOC
545            {
546                // If not black then color will be set in clsMETOC.SetMeTOCProperties()
547                retColor = Color.BLACK;
548            }
549            else if (set == SymbolID.SymbolSet_MineWarfare && (RendererSettings.getInstance().getSeaMineRenderMethod() == RendererSettings.SeaMineRenderMethod_MEDAL))
550            {
551                if(!(entityCode == 110600 || entityCode == 110700))
552                {
553                    switch(affiliation)
554                    {
555                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend:
556                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend:
557                            retColor = AffiliationColors.FriendlyUnitFillColor;//0x00ffff;      // Cyan
558                            break;
559                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker:
560                            retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileUnitFillColor;//Color.RED;//0xff0000;   // Red
561                            break;
562                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker:
563                            if(symStd >= SymbolID.Version_2525E && symStd <= SymbolID.Version_2525Ech1)
564                                retColor = AffiliationColors.SuspectUnitFillColor;//255,188,1
565                            else
566                                retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileUnitFillColor;//Color.RED;//0xff0000;       // Red
567                            break;
568                        case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Neutral:
569                            retColor = AffiliationColors.NeutralUnitFillColor;//0x7fff00;       // Light Green
570                            break;
571                        default://unknown, pending, everything else
572                            retColor = AffiliationColors.UnknownUnitFillColor;//new Color(255,250, 205); //0xfffacd;    // LemonChiffon 255 250 205
573                            break;
574                    }
575                }
576                else
577                {
578                    retColor = Color.BLACK;
579                }
580            }
581            else//everything else
582            {
583                //stopped doing check because all warfighting
584                //should have black for line color.
585                retColor = Color.BLACK;
586            }
587        }
588        catch(Exception e)
589        {
590            // Log Error
591            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolUtilities", "getLineColorOfAffiliation", e);
592            //throw e;
593        }       // End catch
594        return retColor;
595    }   // End get LineColorOfAffiliation

597    /**
598     * For Control Measures, returns the default color for a symbol when it differs from the
599     * affiliation line color.  If there is no default color, returns the value from {@link #getLineColorOfAffiliation}
600     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
601     * @return {@link Color}
602     */
603    public static Color getDefaultLineColor(String symbolID) {
604        try {
605            if (symbolID == null || symbolID.equals("")) {
606                return null;
607            }
608
609            int symbolSet = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
610            int entityCode = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
611            int version = SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID);
612
613            if (symbolSet == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure) {
614                if (entityCode == 200600) { //Cued Acquisition Doctrine
615                    return Color.WHITE;
616                } else if (entityCode == 200700) { //Radar Search Doctrine
617                    return new Color(51, 136, 136);
618                } else if (entityCode == 200101) { //Launch Area
619                    return new Color(255, 155, 0);
620                } else if (entityCode == 200201 || entityCode == 200202) { //Defended Area
621                    return new Color(85, 119, 136);
622                } else if (version >= SymbolID.Version_2525E &&  //TODO: check about APP6E3
623                        (entityCode == 132100 || //key terrain
624                                entityCode == 282001 || //Tower, Low
625                                entityCode == 282002 || //Tower, High
626                                entityCode == 282003)) { // Overhead Wire
627                    return new Color(128, 0, 128);//purple
628                }
629            }
630        } catch (Exception e) {
631            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolUtilities", "getDefaultLineColor", e);
632        }
633        return getLineColorOfAffiliation(symbolID);
634    }

636    /**
637     * METOCs and several Control measures have colors that should not change
638     * @param symbolID 20-30 character id string for symbol
639     * @return true if color should not change
640     */
641    public static boolean hasStaticLineColor(String symbolID)
642    {
643        int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
644        int version = SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID);
645
646        if(ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure)
647        {
648            int ec = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
649            switch (ec)
650            {
651                case 200600: //Cued Acquisition Doctrine
652                case 200700: //Radar Search Doctrine
653                case 200101: //Launch Area
654                    //case 200201: //Defended Area Ellipse/Circle may be depicted as orange (RGB: 255,155,0) where, the area fill is 75% transparent.
655                    //case 200202: //Defended Area Rectangle may be depicted as gray (RGB:85,119,136) where the gray area fill is 75% transparent.
656                    return true;
657                case 132100: //key terrain
658                case 282001: //Tower, Low
659                case 282002: //Tower, High
660                case 282003: // Overhead wire
661                    return version >= SymbolID.Version_2525E;
662                default:
663                    break;
664            }
665            return isGreenProtectionGraphic(symbolID);
666        }
667        else
668            return ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_Atmospheric ||
669                    ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_Oceanographic ||
670                    ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_MeteorologicalSpace;
671    }

693    /**
694     * Determines if the symbol is a tactical graphic
695     *
696     * @param strSymbolID 30 Character {@link String}
697     * @return true if symbol set is 25 (control measure), or is a weather graphic
698     */
699    public static boolean isTacticalGraphic(String strSymbolID) {
700        try {
701            int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(strSymbolID);
702
703            if(ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure || isWeather(strSymbolID)) {
704                return true;
705            }
706        }
707        catch (Exception e) {
708            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolUtilities", "isTacticalGraphic", e);
709        }
710        return false;
711    }

713    /**
714     * Determines if the Symbol can be rendered as a multipoint graphic and not just as an icon
715     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
716     * @return {@link Boolean}
717     */
718    public static boolean isMultiPoint(String symbolID)
719    {
720        MSInfo msi = MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolID);
721        if (msi == null) {
722            return false;
723        }
724        int drawRule = msi.getDrawRule();
725        int ss = msi.getSymbolSet();
726        if(ss != SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure && ss != SymbolID.SymbolSet_Oceanographic && ss != SymbolID.SymbolSet_Atmospheric && ss != SymbolID.SymbolSet_MeteorologicalSpace)
727        {
728            return false;
729        }
730        else if (ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure)
731        {
732            if(msi.getMaxPointCount() > 1)
733                return true;
734            else if((drawRule < DrawRules.POINT1 || drawRule > DrawRules.POINT16 || drawRule == DrawRules.POINT12) &&
735                    drawRule != DrawRules.DONOTDRAW && drawRule != DrawRules.AREA22)
736            {
737                return true;
738            }
739            else
740                return false;
741        }
742        else if(ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_Oceanographic || ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_Atmospheric || ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_MeteorologicalSpace)
743        {
744            if(msi.getMaxPointCount() > 1)
745                return true;
746            else
747                return false;
748        }
749        return false;
750    }

752    public static boolean isActionPoint(String symbolID)
753    {

759                    && ec != 360100 && ec != 360200 && ec != 360300)
760                return true;
761        }
762        return false;

765    /**

767     * @param strSymbolID 30 Character {@link String}

769     + @deprecated see {@link #isSPWithSpecialModifierLayout(String)}

771    public static boolean isTGSPWithSpecialModifierLayout(String strSymbolID)
772    {
773        try
774        {

782                if(SymbolUtilities.isSonobuoy(strSymbolID))

784
785                switch (entityCode)
786                {

789                    case 212800: //harbor

791                    case 210600: //Air Detonation
792                    case 131300: //point of interest
793                    case 131800: //waypoint
794                    case 240900: //fire support station
795                    case 180100: //Air Control point
796                    case 180200: //Communications Check point
797                    case 160300: //T (target reference point)
798                    case 240601: //ap,ap1,x,h (Point/Single Target)
799                    case 240602: //ap (nuclear target)
800                    case 270701: //static depiction
801                    case 282001: //tower, low

805                        return false;

814                    case 110102: //tropopause Low

817                    default:
818                        return false;
819                }
820            }
821        }
822        catch (Exception e) {
823            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolUtilities", "isTGSPWithSpecialModifierLayout", e);
824        }
825        return false;
826    }

828    /**
829     * Returns the fill color for the symbol based on its affiliation
830     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
831     * @return {@link Color}
832     */
833    public static Color getFillColorOfAffiliation(String symbolID)
834    {
835        Color retColor = null;
836        int entityCode = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
837        int entity = SymbolID.getEntity(symbolID);
838        int entityType = SymbolID.getEntityType(symbolID);
839        int entitySubtype = SymbolID.getEntitySubtype(symbolID);
840
841        int affiliation = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
842
843        try
844        {
845            // We can't get the fill color if there is no symbol id, since that also means there is no affiliation
846            if ((symbolID == null) || (symbolID.equals(""))) {
847                return retColor;
848            }
849            if (SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID) == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure) {
850                switch (entityCode) {
851                    case 200101:
852                        retColor = new Color(255, 155, 0, (int) (.25 * 255));
853                        break;
854                    case 200201:
855                    case 200202:
856                    case 200600:
857                        retColor = new Color(85, 119, 136, (int) (.25 * 255));
858                        break;
859                    case 200700:
860                        retColor = new Color(51, 136, 136, (int) (.25 * 255));
861                        break;
862                }
863            }
864            else if (SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID) == SymbolID.SymbolSet_MineWarfare &&
865                    (RendererSettings.getInstance().getSeaMineRenderMethod() == RendererSettings.SeaMineRenderMethod_MEDAL) &&
866                    (!(entityCode == 110600 || entityCode == 110700)))
867            {
868                retColor = new Color(0,0,0,0);//transparent
869            }
870            //just do color by affiliation if no other color has been set yet
871            if (retColor == null) {
872                switch(affiliation)
873                {
874                    case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend:
875                    case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend:
876                        retColor = AffiliationColors.FriendlyUnitFillColor;//0x00ffff;  // Cyan
877                        break;
878                    case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker:
879                        retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileUnitFillColor;//0xfa8072;   // Salmon
880                        break;
881                    case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker:
882                        if(SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID) >= SymbolID.Version_2525E && SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID) <= SymbolID.Version_2525Ech1)
883                            retColor = AffiliationColors.SuspectGraphicFillColor;//255,229,153
884                        else
885                            retColor = AffiliationColors.HostileGraphicFillColor;//Color.RED;//0xff0000;        // Red
886                        break;
887                    case SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Neutral:
888                        retColor = AffiliationColors.NeutralUnitFillColor;//0x7fff00;   // Light Green
889                        break;
890                    default://unknown, pending, everything else
891                        retColor = AffiliationColors.UnknownUnitFillColor;//new Color(255,250, 205); //0xfffacd;        // LemonChiffon 255 250 205
892                        break;
893                }
894            }
895        } // End try
896        catch (Exception e)
897        {
898            // Log Error
899            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolUtilities", "getFillColorOfAffiliation", e);
900            //throw e;
901        }       // End catch
902
903        return retColor;
904    }   // End FillColorOfAffiliation

959    /***
960     * Returns true if graphic is protection graphic (obstacles which render green)
961     * Assumes control measure symbol code where SS == 25
962     * @param entity {@link Integer}
963     * @param entityType {@link Integer}
964     * @param entitySubtype {@link Integer}
965     * @return {@link Boolean}
966     */
967    public static boolean isGreenProtectionGraphic(int entity, int entityType, int entitySubtype)
968    {
969        if(entity >= 27 && entity <= 29)//Protection Areas, Points and Lines
970        {
971            if(entity == 27)
972            {
973                if(entityType > 0 && entityType <= 5)
974                    return true;
975                else if(entityType == 7 || entityType == 8 || entityType == 10 || entityType == 12)
976                {
977                    return true;
978                }
979                else
980                    return false;
981            }
982            else if(entity == 28)
983            {
984                if(entityType > 0 && entityType <= 7)
985                    return true;
986                if(entityType == 19)
987                    return true;
988                else
989                    return false;
990            }
991            else if(entity == 29)
992            {
993                if(entityType >= 01 && entityType <= 05)
994                    return true;
995                else
996                    return false;
997            }
998        }
999        else
1000        {
1001            return false;
1002        }
1003        return false;
1004    }

1236    /**
1237     * Gets the anchor point for single point Control Measure as the anchor point isn't always they center of the symbol.
1238     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
1239     * @param bounds {@link RectF} representing the bound of the core symbol in the image.
1240     * @return {@link Point} representing the point in the image that is the anchor point of the symbol.
1241     */
1242    public static PointF getCMSymbolAnchorPointF(String symbolID, RectF bounds) {
1243        float centerX = (bounds.width() / 2f);
1244        float centerY = (bounds.height() / 2f);
1245
1246        int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
1247        int ec = SymbolID.getEntityCode(symbolID);
1248        int drawRule = 0;
1249
1250        //center/anchor point is always half width and half height except for control measures
1251        //and meteorological
1252        if (ss == SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure) {
1253            drawRule = MSLookup.getInstance().getMSLInfo(symbolID).getDrawRule();
1254            switch (drawRule)//here we check the 'Y' value for the anchor point
1255            {
1256                case DrawRules.POINT1://action points 1301 //bottom center
1257                case DrawRules.POINT5://entry point 2105
1258                case DrawRules.POINT6://ground zero 2107
1259                case DrawRules.POINT7://missile detection point 2111
1260                    centerY = bounds.height()-1;
1261                    break;
1262                case DrawRules.POINT4://drop point 2104 //almost bottom and center
1263                    centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.80f);
1264                    break;
1265                case DrawRules.POINT10://Sonobuoy 2135 //center of circle which isn't center of symbol
1266                    centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.75f);
1267                    break;
1268                case DrawRules.POINT13://booby trap 2807 //almost bottom and center
1269                    centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.74f);
1270                    break;
1271                case DrawRules.POINT15://Marine Life 2189 //center left
1272                    centerX = 0;
1273                    break;
1274                case DrawRules.POINT16://Tower 282001 //circle at base of tower
1275                    centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.89f);
1276                    break;
1277                case DrawRules.POINT2://Several different symbols
1278                    if (ec == 280500)//Wide Area Antitank Mine
1279                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.35f);
1280                    else if (ec == 280400)//Antitank Mine w/ Anti-handling Device
1281                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.33f);
1282                    else if (ec == 280200)//Antipersonnel Mine
1283                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.7f);
1284                    else if (ec == 280201)//Antipersonnel Mine with Directional Effects
1285                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.65f);
1286                    else if (ec == 219000)//Sea Anomaly
1287                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.7f);
1288                    else if (ec == 212500)//Electromagnetic - Magnetic Anomaly Detections (MAD)
1289                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.4f);
1290                    else if (ec/100 == 2135) {//2525E sonobuoys
1291                        centerY = (bounds.height() * 0.75f);
1292                    }
1293                    break;
1294                default:
1295            }
1296
1297            switch (ec)
1298            //have to adjust center X as some graphics have integrated text outside the symbol
1299            {
1300                case 180400: //Pickup Point (PUP)
1301                    centerX = bounds.width() * 0.3341f;
1302                    break;
1303                case 240900: //Fire Support Station
1304                    centerX = bounds.width() * 0.38f;
1305                    break;
1306                case 280201: //Antipersonnel Mine with Directional Effects
1307                    centerX = bounds.width() * 0.43f;
1308                    break;
1309                case 182300: //Orbit - Figure Eight
1310                case 182400: //Orbit - Race Track
1311                case 182500: //Orbit - Random Closed
1312                    if(SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID) >= SymbolID.Version_2525E)
1313                        centerY = bounds.height() * 0.27f;
1314                    break;
1315            }
1316        }
1317
1318        return new PointF((centerX + bounds.left),(centerY + bounds.top));
1319    }

1453    /**
1454     * Reads the Symbol ID string and returns the text that represents the echelon
1455     * code.
1456     * @param echelon {@link Integer} from positions 9-10 in the symbol ID
1457     * See {@link SymbolID#getAmplifierDescriptor(String)}
1458     * @return {@link String} (23 (Army) would be "XXXX")
1459     */
1460    public static String getEchelonText(int echelon)
1461    {
1462        char[] dots = new char[3];
1463        dots[0] = (char)8226;
1464        dots[1] = (char)8226;
1465        dots[2] = (char)8226;
1466        String dot = new String(dots);
1467        String text = null;
1468        if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Team_Crew)
1469        {
1470            text = (char) 216 + "";
1471        }
1472        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Squad)
1473        {
1474            text = dot.substring(0, 1);
1475        }
1476        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Section)
1477        {
1478            text = dot.substring(0, 2);
1479        }
1480        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Platoon_Detachment)
1481        {
1482            text = dot;
1483        }
1484        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Company_Battery_Troop)
1485        {
1486            text = "I";
1487        }
1488        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Battalion_Squadron)
1489        {
1490            text = "II";
1491        }
1492        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Regiment_Group)
1493        {
1494            text = "III";
1495        }
1496        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Brigade)
1497        {
1498            text = "X";
1499        }
1500        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Division)
1501        {
1502            text = "XX";
1503        }
1504        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Corps_MEF)
1505        {
1506            text = "XXX";
1507        }
1508        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Army)
1509        {
1510            text = "XXXX";
1511        }
1512        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_ArmyGroup_Front)
1513        {
1514            text = "XXXXX";
1515        }
1516        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Region_Theater)
1517        {
1518            text = "XXXXXX";
1519        }
1520        else if(echelon == SymbolID.Echelon_Region_Command)
1521        {
1522            text = "++";
1523        }
1524        return text;
1525    }

1527    /**
1528     * Returns the Standard Identity Modifier based on the Symbol ID
1529     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
1530     * @return {@link String}
1531     */
1532    public static String getStandardIdentityModifier(String symbolID)
1533    {
1534        String textChar = null;
1535        int si = SymbolID.getStandardIdentity(symbolID);
1536        int context = SymbolID.getContext(symbolID);
1537        int affiliation = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
1538
1539        if(context == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Context_Simulation)//Simulation
1540            textChar = "S";
1541        else if(context == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Context_Exercise)
1542        {
1543            if(affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker)//exercise Joker
1544                textChar = "J";
1545            else if(affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker)//exercise faker
1546                textChar = "K";
1547            else if(context == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Context_Exercise)//exercise
1548                textChar = "X";
1549        }
1550
1551        return textChar;
1552    }

1558     */
1559    public static boolean hasRectangleFrame(String symbolID)
1560    {
1561        int affiliation = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
1562        int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
1563        if(ss != SymbolID.SymbolSet_ControlMeasure)
1564        {
1565            if (affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend
1566                    || affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend
1567                    || (SymbolID.getContext(symbolID)==SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Context_Exercise &&
1568                    (affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker
1569                            || affiliation == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker)))
1570            {
1571                return true;
1572            }
1573            else
1574                return false;
1575        }
1576        else
1577            return false;
1578    }

1580    /**
1581     * Returns the height ratio for the unit specified by the symbol ID
1582     * Based on Figure 4 in 2525E.
1583     * @param symbolID 30 Character {@link String}
1584     * @return {@link Float}
1585     */
1586    public static float getUnitRatioHeight(String symbolID)
1587    {
1588        int ver = SymbolID.getVersion(symbolID);
1589        int aff = SymbolID.getAffiliation(symbolID);
1590
1591        float rh = 0;
1592
1593        if(ver < SymbolID.Version_2525E)
1594        {
1595            int ss = SymbolID.getSymbolSet(symbolID);
1596
1597            if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker ||
1598                    aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker)
1599            {
1600                switch (ss){
1601                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandCivilianUnit_Organization:
1602                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandUnit:
1603                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandInstallation:
1604                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandEquipment:
1605                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Land:
1606                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Activities:
1607                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_CyberSpace:
1608                        rh = 1.44f;
1609                        break;
1610                    default:
1611                        rh=1.3f;
1612                }
1613            }
1614            else if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend ||
1615                    aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend)
1616            {
1617                switch (ss){
1618                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandCivilianUnit_Organization:
1619                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandUnit:
1620                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandInstallation:
1621                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Activities:
1622                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_CyberSpace:
1623                        rh = 1f;
1624                        break;
1625                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Land:
1626                    default:
1627                        rh=1.2f;
1628                }
1629            }
1630            else if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Neutral)
1631            {
1632                switch (ss){
1633                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandCivilianUnit_Organization:
1634                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandUnit:
1635                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandInstallation:
1636                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandEquipment:
1637                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Land:
1638                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Activities:
1639                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_CyberSpace:
1640                        rh = 1.1f;
1641                        break;
1642                    default:
1643                        rh=1.2f;
1644                }
1645            }
1646            else //UNKNOWN
1647            {
1648                switch (ss){
1649                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandCivilianUnit_Organization:
1650                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandUnit:
1651                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandInstallation:
1652                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_LandEquipment:
1653                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_SignalsIntelligence_Land:
1654                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_Activities:
1655                    case SymbolID.SymbolSet_CyberSpace:
1656                        rh = 1.44f;
1657                        break;
1658                    default:
1659                        rh=1.3f;
1660                }
1661            }
1662        }
1663        else //2525E and up
1664        {
1665            String frameID = SVGLookup.getFrameID(symbolID);
1666            if(frameID.length()==6)
1667                aff = Integer.parseInt(frameID.substring(2,3));
1668            else //"octagon"
1669                return 1f;
1670            char fs = (frameID.charAt(3));
1671
1672            if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Hostile_Faker ||
1673                    aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Suspect_Joker)
1674            {
1675                switch (fs){
1676                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandUnit:
1677                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandInstallation:
1678                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandEquipment:
1679                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_SeaSurface:
1680                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Activity_Event:
1681                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Cyberspace:
1682                        rh = 1.44f;
1683                        break;
1684                    default:
1685                        rh=1.3f;
1686                }
1687            }
1688            else if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Friend ||
1689                    aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_AssumedFriend)
1690            {
1691                switch (fs){
1692                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandUnit:
1693                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandInstallation:
1694                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Activity_Event:
1695                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Cyberspace:
1696                        rh = 1f;
1697                        break;
1698                    default:
1699                        rh=1.2f;
1700                }
1701            }
1702            else if(aff == SymbolID.StandardIdentity_Affiliation_Neutral)
1703            {
1704                switch (fs){
1705                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandUnit:
1706                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandInstallation:
1707                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandEquipment:
1708                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_SeaSurface:
1709                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Activity_Event:
1710                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Cyberspace:
1711                        rh = 1.1f;
1712                        break;
1713                    default:
1714                        rh=1.2f;
1715                }
1716            }
1717            else //UNKNOWN
1718            {
1719                switch (fs){
1720                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandUnit:
1721                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandInstallation:
1722                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_LandEquipment:
1723                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_SeaSurface:
1724                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Activity_Event:
1725                    case SymbolID.FrameShape_Cyberspace:
1726                        rh = 1.44f;
1727                        break;
1728                    default:
1729                        rh=1.3f;
1730                }
1731            }
1732
1733
1734        }
1735
1736        return rh;
1737    }

1893            case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
1894            case TacticalLines.BS_RECTANGLE:
1895            case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
1896            case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
1897            case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
1898            case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
1899            case TacticalLines.BS_BBOX:
1900            case TacticalLines.BS_ROUTE:
1901            case TacticalLines.BS_TRACK:
1902            case TacticalLines.BS_RADARC:
1903            case TacticalLines.BS_CAKE:
1904            case TacticalLines.BS_ORBIT:
1905            case TacticalLines.BS_POLYARC:
